scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-50
scale.headline_number: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black tracking-tight text-emerald-400 font-mono

indian_formatting.rule: Always use Indian numbering system (e.g. ₹74,109 / ₹12,50,000 / 1.2 Lakh / 15 Lakhs). Never standard US comma separation (1,000,000 is invalid; use 10,00,000).

layout_and_spacing.container: max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-6 sm:py-10 space-y-8
layout_and_spacing.header_nav: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/80 border-b border-slate-800 px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between
layout_and_spacing.card_padding: p-5 sm:p-7 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/90 shadow-xl

key_components.name: HeaderNav
key_components.purpose: App header with brand badge ('Offer Decode'), Indian currency tag, and Quick Reset / New Scan button.

key_components.name: LandingHero
key_components.purpose: Two-line value proposition statement + 4 input mode selection cards + Quick scan (Beta) regex prefill option.

key_components.name: InputModesContainer
key_components.purpose: Tabs/Cards for Paste Text, Upload PDF, Upload Images, and Manual Entry Form (CTC, Basic, HRA, Employer PF, Gratuity, Variable Pay, Joining Bonus, ESOPs/yr, Non-cash, Notes).

key_components.name: HeadlineSalaryCard
key_components.purpose: Big, bold card displaying monthly fixed in-hand salary (e.g., ₹74,109/mo) and with-variable monthly total, plus a clear one-line 'how we got this' explanation.

key_components.name: CTCBreakdownStackedBar
key_components.purpose: Visual stacked progress/distribution bar showing Fixed In-hand vs Taxes vs Employer PF/Gratuity vs ESOPs vs Variable Pay.

key_components.name: CTCBreakdownTable
key_components.purpose: Interactive line-item table comparing Annual vs Monthly values for all CTC components with tooltips/labels.

key_components.name: TaxAssumptionsPanel
key_components.purpose: Detailed tax calculation breakdown (Taxable income, regime toggle, slab tax, Sec 87A rebate, Cess 4%, Total annual tax) with live editable sliders/inputs (e.g., 80C, HRA claimed, regime switch).

key_components.name: RedFlagsCard
key_components.purpose: Card highlighting detected offer red flags (clawbacks, long notice periods, variable pay traps, unrealistic ESOP cliff) with 'Why it matters' and exact 'What to ask HR' scripts.

key_components.name: NegotiationTipsCard
key_components.purpose: Actionable, customized negotiation tactics & email templates based on identified weak spots in the offer.

key_components.name: ShareReportModal
key_components.purpose: Generates persistent 90-day shareable report link with copy-to-clipboard button and social sharing buttons.

visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use subtle inset and border gradients like border-emerald-500/30 hover:border-emerald-500/60 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(16,185,129,0.1)]

badge_styles.danger: bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 border border-red-500/30 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold
badge_styles.warning: bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold
badge_styles.success: bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold
badge_styles.info: bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/30 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold

instructions_to_main_agent: Build 'Offer Decode' as a slick, dark-mode mobile-first single-page SaaS tool.
Strictly follow Indian currency formatting (₹, Lakhs, Crores, 10,00,000 comma separators) across all salary numbers.
NO external raster or AI images. Use SVG icons (lucide-react) and clean Tailwind styling.
Provide 4 distinct input tabs: Paste Text, PDF Upload, Image OCR/Upload, Manual Form, plus a prominent 'Quick scan (Beta - sample offer)' button that pre-fills realistic offer text.
Ensure real-time tax recalculation when user changes assumptions (New vs Old Tax Regime, 80C deductions, Section 10 HRA exemption).
Display red flags with clear 'Why it matters' accordion/cards and exact copyable 'What to ask HR' scripts.
Implement persistent sharing using localStorage or backend state with 90-day expiry calculation indicator.
Add data-testid to every interactive component, input field, tab, action button, and key metric card.
